quantize_tensor_to_fp8: quantize a 2D input tensor to FP8 format with dynamic per-token or per-tensor scaling
build_block_fp8_matmul: build a block-wise quantized FP8 matrix multiplication between two tensors with per-block scales
create_per_token_group_quant: create per-token-group quantization of a tensor into signed FP8 with configurable group size
run_mla_fp8_quantization: run specialized FP8 quantization for MLA absorbed case with per-tensor or per-token-group scaling
compute_scaled_mm_triton: compute scaled matrix multiplication with per-token and per-channel scales using a Triton kernel
